text.howto: Bind "content" from state or item; use transform pipelines for derived text (filterBy then count, sum then round then format).

button.howto: Label via the "text" property; wire clicks with eventBindings. One primary button per view.

input.description: Text input, auto-controlled by the runtime.
input.howto: Give it an id and NEVER bind its value; operations read it with an InputBinding {source: "ui-element", sourceId: "<id>"}. For dates use properties {"type": "date"}: the value is YYYY-MM-DD and ISO dates sort and compare correctly as strings. Not allowed inside list children.

textarea.description: Multi-line text input, auto-controlled by the runtime.
textarea.howto: Notes, descriptions, anything multi-line; same rules as input: give it an id, never bind its value, read it with {source: "ui-element", sourceId: "<id>"}. Not allowed inside list children.

timer.description: Invisible interval clock: fires its "tick" event while rendered.
timer.howto: Renders nothing. Wire eventBindings [{"event": "tick", "operationId": "<op id>"}] to run an operation on every tick, e.g. counter.add on an "elapsed" key. Gate it with visibleWhen on a state flag and flip the flag with Start/Stop buttons (state.set): a hidden timer does not tick.

container.howto: Group related elements; use direction "column" for stacked sections and "row" for toolbars.

list.description: Repeats its children once per entry of the bound "items" array.
list.howto: Bind "items" from state (filterBy/sortBy pipelines allowed). Children are the row template; read entry fields with source "item". No input elements inside.

form.description: Form wrapper; submit events get preventDefault.
form.howto: Wrap an entry row to make Enter submit; wire {"event": "submit"} to the same operation as the button.

chart.description: Bar or line chart over an array of objects.
chart.howto: Bind "data" from a state array; "x" names the label field and "y" the numeric field (defaults "key" and "sum", exactly what groupSum emits). Category totals: transforms [{"type": "groupSum", "parameters": {"by": "category", "field": "amount"}}] on the data binding. Per-row computed values chain deriveField first.

pdf.description: PDF viewer with zoom: renders the document its "src" points at.
pdf.howto: Bind "src" from state fed by file.pick's "url" output (an Open button chains file.pick and routes url into state). Set "emptyText" for the before-open message.

document.description: Document viewer for office files and more (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images), rendering whatever its "src" points at.
document.howto: Bind "src" from file.pick's "url" output and "name" from its "name" output. Use file.pick with no kind filter (or kind "pdf") so any document can be chosen. For pdf-only apps prefer the pdf element.

video.description: Video player with controls for the file its "src" points at.
video.howto: Bind "src" from state fed by file.pick's "url" output, exactly like the pdf element.

link.description: Hyperlink; mailto links open the user's mail app.
link.howto: Set "href" and "text". A compose-email link needs no mail service: bind href from an input with a format like {"template": "mailto:{{value}}?subject={{subj}}", "subj": {"source": "element", "sourceId": "subject-in"}}. For real in-app sending use mail.send when the Mailer part is installed.

select.howto: Fixed choices go in properties as a REAL array: "properties": {"options": [{"value": "food", "label": "Food"}, ...]} (a bare ["a","b"] also works). Only bind options when they come from state. Operations read the selection via {source: "ui-element", sourceId: "<id>"}.

checkbox.howto: Standalone: auto-controlled, read via {source: "ui-element"}. Inside list rows: bind "checked" from {source: "item"} and wire {"event": "change"} to list.toggleField.

progress.howto: Bind "value" from state (sum/count pipelines work well).

state.set.description: Writes a value to a state key.
state.set.howto: Use for toggles and view switching: bind "key" and "value" as constants (use the typed "value" field for booleans and numbers), then show panels with visibleWhen equals on that key.

counter.add.description: Adds an amount (default 1) to a numeric state key.
counter.add.howto: Seed the key in initialState. Negative amounts subtract.

list.append.description: Appends an item to an array state key. Item fields come from inputs named item.<field>; the part generates the id itself.

inputs.name: item.<field>
inputs.description: One input per item field, e.g. item.title, item.amount

list.append.howto: Never supply item.id; it is generated. Skips silently when every item field is blank. Use the parseNumber transform on numeric fields fed from text inputs.

list.updateWhere.description: Updates matching items in an array state key. Fields to write come from inputs named set.<field>.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value the match field must equal

inputs.name: set.<field>
inputs.description: One input per field to write

list.updateWhere.howto: Typical row edit: value from {source: 'item', sourceId: 'id'}.

list.removeWhere.description: Removes matching items from an array state key.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value the match field must equal

list.removeWhere.howto: Typical row delete: value from {source: 'item', sourceId: 'id'}.

list.toggleField.description: Flips a boolean field on the matching item of an array state key.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Id of the item to toggle

list.toggleField.howto: Typical row toggle: id from {source: 'item', sourceId: 'id'}. Show the flag: bind the row text's className from it (map {'true': 'done'}) and count remaining rows with filterFalsy.

math.add.description: Adds two numbers. Returns {result}. Route the result with an OutputBinding.
math.add.howto: Pure calculation; write the result to state with an OutputBinding when it should display.

time.now.description: The current date and time. Route the outputs you need into state.
time.now.howto: To stamp new list entries, run this FIRST on the same click (bindings run in order): first binding writes date to a state key, the second binding is the list.append whose "item.date" input reads that key {source: "state", sourceId: "<key>"}. Display stamps with the formatDate transform.

random.int.description: A uniform random whole number between min and max, both included.
random.int.howto: Dice and roll patterns: bind min and max as typed constants, run on a click, route value into a state key shown by a text element. Numeric strings coerce.

random.pick.description: Picks one entry of an array at random.
random.pick.howto: Random picker pattern: collect options with list.append, bind list from that state key, run on a click, and route value into a state key. When entries are objects from list.append, show a field by adding a pick transform on the value output, e.g. transforms [{"type": "pick", "parameters": {"field": "title"}}].

http.get.description: Fetches JSON from an http(s) URL. Returns {response}. Route the response with an OutputBinding into state.
http.get.howto: Fetching real remote data ONLY; never for math on existing state (use expr.evaluate, stats, or transforms for that). A computed URL is a url input bound from an element or state with a format transform, e.g. transforms [{"type": "format", "parameters": {"template": "https://host/search?q={{value}}"}}]. Route the response into a state key and display it with pick/format.

file.pick.description: Opens the system file picker. Returns {file, url, name, size, mime}: "file" is a token file.read consumes; "url" is what pdf, video, and image elements bind their src to.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Filter: pdf | image | video | markdown | text; omit for any file

file.pick.howto: Wire it to an Open button, route "url" into state for a viewer's src binding and "name" into state for a caption. Route "file" into state only when a converter needs the bytes via file.read. Cancelling the dialog stops the chain.

file.read.description: Reads a picked file as base64. Input "file" is file.pick's token; returns {base64, name, mime, size} for compute parts to consume.
file.read.howto: Chain on the same click after file.pick: pick routes "file" into state, file.read takes it from state and routes "base64" (binary parts) or "text" (markdown and text parts) into state for the converter step. Only user-picked files are readable.

file.save.description: Saves base64 data through the system save panel. Inputs: data (base64), name (suggested filename). Returns {saved, name}.
file.save.howto: The last step of a converter chain: feed it the converter's base64 output from state and suggest a filename with the right extension. The user picks where it lands; cancelling stops the chain.

email.send.description: Sends a plain-text email through the mail server the user configured in DER Settings. Inputs: to, subject, text, optional from. Returns {sent, to}.

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: Sender address; omit to use the default from Settings

email.send.howto: Wire a Send button: bind "to", "subject", and "text" from the form inputs, composing the body with format when the app collects separate fields. Leave "from" unbound; the configured account supplies it. Route "sent" into state and gate a confirmation text on it with visibleWhen truthy. Sending fails with a clear message until the user adds their mail server in Settings.

todos.add.description: Appends a todo {id, title, completed:false} to the 'todos' state array.

todos.toggle.description: Flips 'completed' on the todo with the given id in the 'todos' state array.

todos.remove.description: Removes the todo with the given id from the 'todos' state array.

transforms.name: count
transforms.description: Number of entries in an array (0 for anything else).

transforms.name: sum
transforms.description: Sum of a numeric field across an array of objects.

transforms.name: filterBy
transforms.description: Keeps array entries whose field equals the given value; an empty value keeps everything, so an "All" dropdown option can use value "".

transforms.name: filterContains
transforms.description: Keeps array entries whose field contains the given text, case-insensitive; empty text keeps everything. Bind value dynamically for live search.

transforms.name: filterTruthy
transforms.description: Keeps array entries whose field is truthy (set flags, checked rows).

transforms.name: filterFalsy
transforms.description: Keeps array entries whose field is falsy or missing (e.g. not-completed rows; a row that never got the flag counts).

transforms.name: sortBy
transforms.description: Sorts an array by a field; numeric when both values are numbers.

transforms.name: deriveField
transforms.description: Adds a computed field to every row of an array: an arithmetic expression over that row's numeric fields (e.g. field "value", expression "qty * price"). Rows keep their other fields; read the new field like any row field, sum it for totals, or sortBy it.

transforms.name: groupSum
transforms.description: Groups an array of objects by a field and sums another per group; returns [{key, sum}] in first-seen order. The chart element's natural feed (x "key", y "sum").

transforms.name: pick
transforms.description: Reads a field (dot path allowed) from an object; an array reads from its first entry, so filterBy then pick gives the matched entry's field.

transforms.name: pluck
transforms.description: Field values across an array of objects (turns [{value: 5}, ...] into [5, ...]; use before count/sum or numeric part inputs).

transforms.name: equals
transforms.description: True when the value equals the given value.

transforms.name: parseNumber
transforms.description: Converts input text to a number (0 when not numeric).

transforms.name: round
transforms.description: Rounds a number to the given decimals.

transforms.name: format
transforms.description: Inserts the value into a template at {{value}}; every other {{name}} slot fills from a same-named parameter (parameters may be live references).

transforms.name: formatNumber
transforms.description: Formats a number with thousands separators and fixed decimals, optional prefix/suffix (e.g. "$ ", " EUR").

transforms.name: formatDate
transforms.description: Formats a date (ISO string or epoch milliseconds) for display; style date|time|datetime|weekday.

transforms.name: map
transforms.description: Maps the value through a lookup table (mapping[String(value)]).
